What we do

Scope of services

01

Construction Oversight

On-site and virtual oversight of construction progress across MEP and controls systems relevant to commissioning.

02

Readiness Tracking

Coordinating Level 1 design/installation verification, Level 2 startup preparation, and Level 3 functional test readiness.

03

Pinch-Point Identification

Surfacing sequencing conflicts, submittal delays, trade coordination gaps, and testing readiness issues before they cost schedule.

04

Leadership Reporting

Regular reporting to project leadership on readiness status, open risks, and mitigation recommendations.

05

Cx Agent Coordination

Direct communication with the project's Commissioning Agent to support a clean, well-documented Level 3 to Level 4 handoff.

06

Turnover Review

Reviewing punch lists and turnover documentation prior to Cx Agent engagement at Level 4.

About us

Independent oversight, built for hyperscale delivery.

Oak Cx Solutions provides advisory, oversight, and coordination support for commissioning readiness on hyperscale data center projects, tracking risk through Level 1-3 and delivering a clean, well-documented handoff to the project's Commissioning Agent at Level 4.

We are not the Commissioning Agent of record, and we do not perform functional performance testing or issue commissioning certifications. That separation keeps our reporting to owners and general contractors independent, focused on schedule, sequencing, and readiness risk, with no conflict of interest with the CxA on your project.
